items.text: Round 1 has 4 unresolved decisions (d1: target scenario, d2: core idea, d3: target user, d5: acceptance paths). Only d4 (priority) was pre-selected as 'keep at 5'. The plan remains entirely TBD until these foundational questions are answered. This round re-approaches the critical unknowns with more specific prompts.

items.topic: Can you describe the idea in one sentence?
items.context: The item title is 'No Effort' but the description field is empty. Without understanding what this idea IS, no planning can proceed. Even a rough sentence would unblock all downstream work. If this is a test/placeholder item, that's also fine to declare.

options.label: This is a test/placeholder item
options.rationale: Created to test the backlog system, no real implementation intended

options.label: A tool/feature that requires zero user effort to use
options.rationale: Something that works automatically without configuration or manual steps

options.label: A way to estimate effort for backlog items
options.rationale: Meta-feature: the 'no effort' name refers to items lacking effort estimates

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Provide a one-sentence description in the freeform field

items.topic: Is this idea connected to any existing work or initiative?
items.context: Understanding if this relates to ongoing efforts would help narrow scope and approach. The item has no tags, no initiative, and no dependencies set.

options.label: Standalone idea — not connected to existing work
Related to swarm-manager backlog improvements
options.rationale: Could be about enhancing how items are processed or estimated

options.label: Related to agent-manager capabilities
options.rationale: Could involve improving how agents handle tasks

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Specify the connection in the freeform field

items.topic: What is the expected size of this work?
items.context: Even without full details, a rough size estimate helps set expectations for planning depth and workshop rounds needed.

options.label: Small — a few hours of work, single file or config change
Medium — a few days, multiple files within one scenario
Large — a week+, new scenario or cross-scenario changes
Unknown — need to define the idea first
options.rationale: Can't estimate until the core concept is clear

items.topic: Should this item be archived if it's a placeholder?
items.context: If this item was created as a test or lacks a real purpose, it may be better to archive it rather than keep it in the backlog. Keeping empty items adds noise to the backlog.

options.label: Keep in backlog — it has a real purpose
options.rationale: The idea is genuine, just needs description added

options.label: Archive — this was a test item
options.rationale: Clean up the backlog by removing placeholder items

options.label: Other
options.rationale: Specify what to do with this item

plan_updates: No plan updates this round — all plan sections remain TBD pending resolution of foundational decisions from rounds 1 and 2. The critical path is: define the idea (r2-d1) → identify target scenario (r1-d1) → set acceptance boundaries (r1-d5) → populate plan sections.
